TELEPORT_MAP_HELP: Tap a green camp to select it, then Confirm Teleport. Blue marks where you are.
TELEPORT_STAGE_NONE: You have no other camp on this map. Choose another map above.
TELEPORT_CAMP_LOCKED: This camp is locked. Unlock it at the camp to teleport there.
OFFLINE_LOCKED_EXPLAIN: Unlock Offline upgrades to earn weapons, outfits, and supplies while away. Unlocks apply to future time away only. Go to Upgrades claims these rewards first.
